LanguageData.RM_SeaDiveNotAtSea: this hatch is not currently over open water
LanguageData.RM_SeaDiveHatchNeedsGravEngine: needs a working grav engine somewhere on this ship
LanguageData.RM_ElderDischargeUnprompted: {0} suddenly releases a blinding discharge across the pool. Anything nearby is stunned, and any active shield has collapsed.
LanguageData.RM_ElderDischargeDisturbed: Disturbed, {0} discharges! Anything nearby is stunned, and any active shield has collapsed.
LanguageData.RM_ElderChargeInspect: Charge: {0}% (watch for crackling light along its limbs)
LanguageData.RM_OfferToElderDesc: Offer a specimen — a corpse, mineral, or unfamiliar material — to this Elder. It values novelty above all: the first of a kind it has ever seen here is worth a great deal; anything it has already catalogued is worth almost nothing.
LanguageData.RM_OfferToElderInstructions: It reports what has changed in the water, never who brought it. Select something to offer — this Elder remembers everything it has ever been shown, but only at this pool.
LanguageData.RM_ElderOfferConfirmNovel: Offer {0} to the Elder? It has never seen this kind of thing at this pool — it should pay dearly for it. This consumes the item entirely.
LanguageData.RM_ElderOfferConfirmStale: Offer {0} to the Elder? It has already catalogued this kind of thing here and will pay almost nothing. This consumes the item entirely.
LanguageData.RM_ElderOfferResultTreasure: The pool dissolves around a jacketed shape. The Elder has given up {0} — one of a kind, and this was its only one.
LanguageData.RM_ElderOfferResultNovel: The pool dissolves around a buried shape: {0} silver rises to the shore. This is the only time this kind of thing will pay so well, here.
LanguageData.RM_ElderOfferResultStale: The Elder has already catalogued this. A token {0} silver surfaces — the chemistry held nothing new for it.
LanguageData.RM_HeatedSuitChargeDepleted: Suit battery: DEPLETED — no cold protection
LanguageData.RM_ChillGardenDefense_IlissArc: Arcs of current lash out from the frost around {0} — the garden is defending itself.
LanguageData.RM_ChillGardenDefense_TarnnWokeReason: disturbed by sustained destruction of the seabed garden
LanguageData.RM_ChillGardenDefense_TarnnWokeText: Sustained destruction of the garden has roused {0} dormant Tarnn — scenery no longer. They will fight until this is settled, and stay settled once it is.
LanguageData.RM_ChillAuroraSurge_StartText: The electrojet spikes overhead. Down here every Iliss lights along its spine, the skyharps shimmer string by string, and arcs begin walking the conductive frost. The electrojet mast will draw real power while this lasts — but anyone caught outside, suited or not, is not safe from the current.
LanguageData.RM_ChillAuroraSurge_End: The surge fades. The floor settles back to its usual quiet glow.
LanguageData.RM_ChillAuroraSurge_ShockHit: {0} is caught in the open as the storm's current arcs through them!
LanguageData.RM_AuroraCollectorNotChillSeabed: Not on the Chill seabed — this mast can never draw current here.
LanguageData.RM_AuroraCollectorRoofed: Roofed — no open access to the sky the surge reaches through.
LanguageData.RM_AuroraCollectorHarvesting: Aurora surge active — harvesting at {0} of peak output.
